'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Matt Hanson LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Hanson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
